stories.headline: Intel Joins Musk's Terafab AI Chip Megaproject Alongside SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI

key_facts.fact: Intel announced it will join Elon Musk's Terafab AI chip complex project in Austin, Texas, alongside SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel will join SpaceX and Tesla in an effort to build a new U.S. semiconductor factory in Texas

key_facts.fact: Intel will contribute process technology, design, fabrication, and advanced chip packaging capabilities to the project, which targets 1 TW/year of compute for AI and robotics.
key_facts.excerpt: "Our ability to design, fabricate, and package ultra-high-performance chips at scale will help accelerate Terafab's aim to produce 1 TW/year of compute to power future advances in AI and robotics," Intel said

key_facts.fact: The Terafab initiative includes plans for two advanced chip plants at a large Austin, Texas facility, with one focused on logic and one on memory.
key_facts.excerpt: The Terafab initiative includes plans for two advanced chip plants at a large Austin, Texas facility, with one focused on logic and memory chips

key_facts.fact: Intel's stock rose approximately 2.9%, trading at $52.28 at 2 p.m. ET on the news.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel's stock rose more than 3% on the news today. It was trading at $52.28, about 2.9% higher than its opening bell price, at 2 p.m. ET

key_facts.fact: Building a chip fab typically requires more than $20 billion and years of construction; Terafab is estimated at $25 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel Lands Musk's $25 Billion Terafab: A Billion-Dollar Foundry Win in the Making?

stories.headline: Super Micro Launches Independent Probe After Cofounder Indicted in $2.5B Nvidia Chip Smuggling Scheme

key_facts.fact: Super Micro board directors Scott Angel and Tally Liu are leading an independent investigation, with law firm Munger, Tolles & Olson and consulting firm AlixPartners hired to advise.
key_facts.excerpt: The board's newest director, Scott Angel, who was appointed to be the independent leader on the board, is running point on the latest investigation, along with audit committee chair Tally Liu

key_facts.fact: The DOJ last month charged cofounder Yih-Shyan 'Wally' Liaw and two others for allegedly routing $2.5 billion in Supermicro servers packed with Nvidia GPUs to China via a front company in Southeast Asia.
key_facts.excerpt: Liaw, Ruei-Tsang 'Steven' Chang, and Ting-Wei 'Willy' Sun allegedly arranged for thousands of fake replica servers to be stored in a warehouse to trick government auditors

key_facts.fact: The defendants allegedly arranged thousands of fake replica servers and used hair dryers to remove and reaffix packaging labels to deceive government auditors.
key_facts.excerpt: The trio went to great lengths to perpetrate the subterfuge, the indictment claims, including using hair dryers to remove packaging labels that were then reaffixed to thousands of fake replica servers

key_facts.fact: A previous 2024 board investigation found 'no evidence' that anyone at the company tried to circumvent export control regulations, after former auditor Ernst & Young resigned mid-audit.
key_facts.excerpt: The committee reviewed 11 export transactions and 'did not see any evidence suggesting that anyone at the company tried to circumvent export control regulations or restrictions'

key_facts.fact: Supermicro also initiated an internal review of its global trade compliance program, led by general counsel Yitai Hu, with findings reported directly to independent board directors.
key_facts.excerpt: Supermicro also announced it has initiated an internal review of its global trade compliance program, led by general counsel Yitai Hu

stories.headline: Bain's Bridge Data Centres Cuts Ties With Megaspeed Amid US Probe Into Nvidia Chip Diversion to China

key_facts.fact: Bain Capital-backed Bridge Data Centres replaced tenant Megaspeed International with cloud services provider Zenlayer at its Malaysian facility.
key_facts.excerpt: The Bain Capital-backed data centre operator removed Megaspeed International from its Malaysian facility and replaced it with cloud services provider Zenlayer

key_facts.fact: The US government is investigating Megaspeed's ownership structure and whether it was involved in the unauthorized transfer of advanced Nvidia AI chips to China.
key_facts.excerpt: The move follows a US government investigation into Megaspeed's ownership structure and whether it was involved in the unauthorized transfer of advanced Nvidia AI chips to China

key_facts.fact: Bridge Data Centres is reportedly exploring fundraising opportunities, including discussions in March to raise $6 billion for expansion in Thailand.
key_facts.excerpt: the company is reportedly exploring fundraising opportunities, including discussions in March to raise $6 billion for expansion in Thailand

key_facts.fact: The tenant swap is seen as a strategic move to 'clean up' Bridge's asset base as it prepares for potential investment activity amid intensifying regulatory oversight of AI chip flows.
key_facts.excerpt: The tenant swap is seen as a strategic step to 'clean up' the company's asset base at a time when regulatory oversight around AI chips and cross-border technology flows is intensifying

stories.headline: Core Scientific Expands Data Center Financing to $1B With New $500M J.P. Morgan Commitment

key_facts.fact: Core Scientific closed an additional $500 million commitment from J.P. Morgan, bringing total funded commitments under its credit facility to $1.0 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: This brings total funded commitments under the Facility to $1.0 billion, including the previously announced $500 million commitment from Morgan Stanley

key_facts.fact: The 364-day credit facility carries interest at SOFR plus 250 basis points, with the previous $500 million tranche committed by Morgan Stanley.
key_facts.excerpt: Borrowings under the Facility bear interest at a rate of the Secured Overnight Financing Rate ('SOFR') plus 250 basis points (2.50%)

key_facts.fact: Proceeds will fund data center asset development including equipment purchases, real property acquisition, and energy procurement as Core Scientific converts mining facilities to high-density AI colocation.
key_facts.excerpt: The Company expects to use proceeds from borrowings under the Facility for general corporate purposes related to the development of data center assets

sources.title: Core Scientific Expands Strategic Financing Facility to $1 Billion with Additional $500 Million Commitment from J.P. Morgan

stories.headline: Aria Networks Raises $125M Series A to Build AI-Native Networking for AI Chip Clusters

key_facts.fact: Aria Networks, a one-year-old startup, raised a $125 million Series A led by Sutter Hill Ventures to build AI-native networking software for optimizing AI cluster performance.
key_facts.excerpt: Aria Networks raised a $125 million Series A from Sutter Hill and others. The one-year-old startup builds AI-native networking software designed to optimize AI cluster performance

key_facts.fact: The platform is designed to work with any AI chip on the market, including Nvidia and Google, and focuses on optimizing cost per token and model FLOPs utilization.
key_facts.excerpt: Aria says its platform is built around token efficiency, which it treats as a measure of AI output relative to running costs

key_facts.fact: CEO Mansour Karam previously founded Apstra, an intent-based networking company acquired by Juniper Networks in 2021.
key_facts.excerpt: Karam previously founded Apstra, which Juniper Networks acquired in 2021, giving him a prior run in intent-based networking

key_facts.fact: Aria sells to AI-focused system integrators, neocloud builders, and managed AI infrastructure providers delivering full AI factories.
key_facts.excerpt: Aria is working with AI-focused system integrators, neocloud builders and managed AI infrastructure providers that deliver full AI factories

stories.headline: Ubtech Partners With Honda Trading to Deploy Humanoid Robots in Manufacturing Logistics

key_facts.fact: Ubtech's smart logistics unit UQI Robotics signed a strategic partnership with Honda Trading China to jointly develop humanoid robots and unmanned logistics vehicles for industrial manufacturing.
key_facts.excerpt: Ubtech's smart logistics unit, UQI Robotics, signed the agreement with Honda Trading China to jointly conduct research into applications for humanoid robots and unmanned logistics vehicles

key_facts.fact: Ubtech's sales revenue from full-sized humanoid robots (taller than 160cm) jumped 23-fold to CNY820.6 million ($119.4 million) in 2025, lifting total revenue 53% to CNY2 billion ($290 million).
key_facts.excerpt: Ubtech's sales revenue from full-sized humanoid robots, defined as those taller than 160 centimeters, jumped 23-fold to CNY820.6 million (USD119.4 million) last year

key_facts.fact: Ubtech's net loss narrowed 32% to CNY789.8 million despite the revenue surge, and the company launched a global recruitment drive including a chief scientist role with salary up to CNY124 million ($2.2 million starting).
key_facts.excerpt: its net loss narrowed 32 percent to CNY789.8 million... announced a global recruitment drive for dozens of core research and development positions related to embodied intelligence

key_facts.fact: The partnership will explore potential industrial uses for Ubtech's flagship Walker series humanoid robots and include cooperation on regional distribution and technological innovation.
key_facts.excerpt: The partnership will also explore potential industrial uses for Ubtech's flagship Walker series of humanoid robots

stories.headline: Robotics Giant Kuka Shifts Investment to US and Asia, Says Europe Too Slow on AI

key_facts.fact: Kuka, one of the world's largest industrial robotics suppliers, is prioritizing investments in the US and Asia as Europe's industrial companies lag in AI adoption.
key_facts.excerpt: Many of Europe's industrial companies are too slow to adopt AI, putting faster-moving global rivals in a position to overtake them, according to German-Chinese robotics maker Kuka

key_facts.fact: The German-Chinese robotics maker warned that faster-moving global rivals are positioned to overtake European manufacturers that have been slow to integrate AI into industrial production.
key_facts.excerpt: Many of Europe's industrial companies are too slow to adopt AI, putting faster-moving global rivals in a position to overtake them

key_facts.fact: Kuka is owned by Chinese appliance maker Midea Group, making it a uniquely positioned player straddling European industrial heritage and Chinese manufacturing scale.
key_facts.excerpt: German-Chinese robotics maker Kuka
